recognize_zh: 低倍骨髓切片左側一小團細胞核深染、互相擠壓變形的細胞（crush artifact）位於疏鬆纖維黏液樣基質中，與右側含脂肪、三系造血的正常骨髓明顯不同；高核質比的小圓藍細胞易被擠壓，在尤文氏肉瘤分期時應提高警覺並做 CD99 染色。
features: Focus at left of crushed, hyperchromatic cells with high N:C ratio and smeared nuclear chromatin
Crushed cells lie within loose edematous/fibromyxoid stroma, distinct from surrounding marrow
Adjacent marrow at right is normocellular with fat spaces and trilineage hematopoiesis including megakaryocytes
Bone trabeculae at left and right edges; no well-preserved tumor morphology
describe_en: Low-power view of the staging bone marrow core biopsy shows a discrete focus at the left composed of crushed, hyperchromatic cells with high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratio set in a loose, edematous stroma, sharply distinct from the adjacent normocellular marrow with maturing trilineage hematopoiesis. The crush artifact precludes detailed cytologic assessment. In the context of Ewing sarcoma staging, the focus is suspicious for metastatic tumor, and immunohistochemistry (CD99, NKX2.2) is required for confirmation; CD99 confirmed involvement in this case.

ddx.dx: Crushed normal lymphoid aggregate or hematogones
ddx.vs: Benign lymphoid aggregates are circumscribed, lack stromal desmoplasia and stain for CD3/CD20 rather than CD99/NKX2.2.
Neuroblastoma also yields crushed small round blue cells but shows neuropil/rosettes and is PHOX2B/synaptophysin positive and CD99 negative.
Lymphoblasts are CD99 positive like Ewing sarcoma but express TdT and CD45.
Rhabdomyosarcoma is desmin and myogenin positive.
